    • validate

      void validate(tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode config)
      Checks the configuration that may be saved into a layout. Anything not accepted here can never be persisted.

    • validateTransient

      default void validateTransient(tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode override)
      Checks settings a card changes for a single read - a chosen date, for instance - which are merged over the saved configuration and then discarded.

      This is deliberately separate from validate(JsonNode): the save path runs that one, so a property accepted there becomes storable. A widget with no such settings inherits the default and refuses every override.

      Parameters:
      override - the properties of this read alone, never null and always an object
